@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Last night, the police s______ded a factory in which a criminal was hiding and finally managed to catch him.
= surrounded
~詞義 surround（v.）圍繞
~原文 Last night, the police surrounded a factory in which a criminal was hiding and finally managed to catch him.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Upon seeing Jessica, Jill turned around and walked to the o______e direction.
= opposite
~詞義 opposite（adj.）相反的
~原文 Upon seeing Jessica, Jill turned around and walked to the opposite direction.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: A detective was employed to conduct an i______n into the murder case.
= investigation
~詞義 investigation（n.）調查
~原文 A detective was employed to conduct an investigation into the murder case.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The negotiations between North Korea and South Korea were ______ (significance) because they improved the relationship between the two nations.
= significant
~詞義 significant（adj.）重要的
~原文 The negotiations between North Korea and South Korea were significant because they improved the relationship between the two nations.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The poem is ______ (represent) of the poet's early style, when he focused on nature and peaceful countryside scenes.
= representative
~詞義 representative（adj.）有代表性的
~原文 The poem is representative of the poet's early style, when he focused on nature and peaceful countryside scenes.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Besides being an excellent ______, Nathan always showed good sportsmanship (體育精神) and encouraged his teammates.
A: magician
B: suspect
C: athlete
D: civilian
= C
~詞義 athlete（n.）運動員
~原文 Besides being an excellent athlete, Nathan always showed good sportsmanship (體育精神) and encouraged his teammates.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Thanks to the instant messaging apps, people can now ______ with others much more easily than before.
A: define
B: frighten
C: communicate
D: harvest
= C
~詞義 communicate（v.）溝通
~原文 Thanks to the instant messaging apps, people can now communicate with others much more easily than before.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The customer ______ to the manager of the restaurant's poor service and asked for a refund.
A: complained
B: ranked
C: faded
D: marched
= A
~詞義 complain（v.）抱怨
~原文 The customer complained to the manager of the restaurant's poor service and asked for a refund.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: According to a survey conducted by the Ministry of Health and Welfare in 2020, the most ______ cause of death in Taiwan is heart disease.
A: additional
B: magical
C: naive
D: frequent
= D
~詞義 frequent（adj.）頻繁的
~原文 According to a survey conducted by the Ministry of Health and Welfare in 2020, the most frequent cause of death in Taiwan is heart disease.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In our society, individuals accused of a crime are supposed to be considered ______ until proven guilty by a judge.
A: additional
B: technical
C: magical
D: innocent
= D
~詞義 innocent（adj.）無罪的;清白的
~原文 In our society, individuals accused of a crime are supposed to be considered innocent until proven guilty by a judge.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: opposed
B: investigated
C: civil
D: graduated
E: compete
F: rough

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Kate ______ from medical school last year. Now she works in a hospital.
= D
~詞義 graduate（v.）畢業
~原文 Kate graduated from medical school last year. Now she works in a hospital.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Robert had a(n) ______ time adjusting to the new school after his family moved to another city.
= F
~詞義 rough（adj.）艱困的
~原文 Robert had a(n) rough time adjusting to the new school after his family moved to another city.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: In every democratic country, people should have basic ______ rights, including the right to vote and to express their opinions.
= C
~詞義 civil（adj.）公民的
~原文 In every democratic country, people should have basic civil rights, including the right to vote and to express their opinions.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is impossible for most small grocery stores to ______ with large supermarkets.
= E
~詞義 compete（v.）競爭
~原文 It is impossible for most small grocery stores to compete with large supermarkets.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: This study ______ the negative effects of violent video games on children.
= B
~詞義 investigate（v.）調查
~原文 This study investigated the negative effects of violent video games on children.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: competitive
B: completed
C: suspicious
D: strengths
E: harvested
F: graduation

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the manager ______ his tasks for the day, he went home.
= B
~詞義 complete（v.）完成
~原文 After the manager completed his tasks for the day, he went home.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: This year, the college invited the mayor to speak at its ______ ceremony.
= F
~詞義 graduation（n.）畢業
~原文 This year, the college invited the mayor to speak at its graduation ceremony.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The farmer quickly ______ the vegetables before the hurricane came.
= E
~詞義 harvest（v.）收割
~原文 The farmer quickly harvested the vegetables before the hurricane came.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: In today's ______ world, children are often expected to achieve excellence in their academic performance.
= A
~詞義 competitive（adj.）競爭的
~原文 In today's competitive world, children are often expected to achieve excellence in their academic performance.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: One of Jenny's greatest ______ is her ability to stay calm and think clearly under pressure.
= D
~詞義 strength（n.）優點
~原文 One of Jenny's greatest strengths is her ability to stay calm and think clearly under pressure.
